# CANDIDATE: OPTIMIZED_RIBBON_SPREAD_THRESHOLD

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Optimizing the ribbon spread threshold (currently 30 cents) in the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will improve edge capture on J's winner days while avoiding excessive losses on loser days. The current threshold may be too strict or too loose; we seek the value that maximizes edge capture on the 3 J winner days.

## Mechanism

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup requires the EMA ribbon spread (Fast EMA to Slow EMA) to be at least X cents. We will backtest a range of X values (e.g., 10, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50 cents) on the full 16-month dataset to find the value that maximizes edge capture (as per OP-16) on the J winner days, then validate with walk-forward OOS and real-fills on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** We will use the full 16-month dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for Stage-1 optimization. Selection method: grid search over ribbon spread thresholds. Overfit risk: mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills on J days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be performed after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (to be done on top 3 J days after OOS)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: if threshold too loose, may take losing trades on choppy days; if too tight, may miss winners.
   - Max drawdown: to be determined after backtest.
   - Blow-up scenario: extreme volatility causing multiple stopped-out trades if threshold is too loose and market whipsaws.
6. **Concentration:** To be determined after backtest; we will disclose if top-5 days exceed X% of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass (103/104 PASS, excluding pre-existing market-closed skip). Walk-forward OOS test must show edge_capture >= 771 and Sharpe > 0. Real-fills on top 3 J days must show no regression (delta edge_capture >= -50 vs current) and P&L difference < ±20% vs BS sim. Additionally, must not break any J-RATIFIED candidates' anchor behavior.

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- We have no data yet; the optimization may or may not yield improvement. The current 30-cent threshold is based on heuristics.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This candidate optimizes a parameter of the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup, which is used in multiple strategies. It does not directly add a new line to the leaderboard but may affect the edge_capture of existing strategies that rely on this setup. We will re-score affected candidates after optimization. No conflict with current leaderboard entries as it is a parameter refinement, not a new strategy.
